import re
fs_access_token = apis.file_system.login(username='cheweber@gmail.com', password=[c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='file_system'][0])['access_token']
content = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path='~/backups/music_library.md', access_token=fs_access_token)['content']
lines = [ln.rstrip('\n') for ln in content.splitlines()]

# Parse sections
section = None
songs = []
albums = []
playlists = {}  # title -> list of tracks tuples (title, artists string)
current_playlist = None

for ln in lines:
    if ln.startswith('# Song Library'):
        section = 'songs'
        current_playlist = None
        continue
    if ln.startswith('# Album Library'):
        section = 'albums'
        current_playlist = None
        continue
    if ln.startswith('# Playlists'):
        section = 'playlists'
        current_playlist = None
        continue
    if section == 'playlists':
        m = re.match(r'^##\s*(.+)$', ln)
        if m:
            current_playlist = m.group(1).strip()
            playlists[current_playlist] = []
            continue
        # Track lines begin with '-'
        m = re.match(r'^-\s*(.+?)\s+by\s+(.+)$', ln)
        if m and current_playlist:
            track_title = m.group(1).strip()
            artists = m.group(2).strip()
            # In backup, multi artists separated by comma+space
            playlists[current_playlist].append((track_title, artists))

    else:
        # Parse song/album lines
        if section in ('songs','albums'):
            m = re.match(r'^-\s*(.+?)\s+by\s+(.+)$', ln)
            if m:
                title = m.group(1).strip()
                artists = m.group(2).strip()
                if section=='songs':
                    songs.append((title, artists))
                else:
                    albums.append((title, artists))

print('songs', len(songs))
print('albums', len(albums))
print('playlists', len(playlists))
print('playlist_names', list(playlists.keys()))
print('first_song', songs[0])
print('first_album', albums[0])
print('first_playlist_track_count', len(next(iter(playlists.values()))))

def split_artists(artists_str):

    return [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',') if a.strip()]
